body.statement: For any tangent-rich completion \(Q\) of \(P\), the compatible target set contains a relatively open neighborhood of \(\theta(Q)\) in \(\theta(Q)+R_0\ker(A_P)\), and this affine space has dimension \(\nu(P)\).
body.justification: The result upgrades a binary identified-or-not verdict to a local dimension of causal ambiguity.
body.gap: Existing nonunique-bridge results do not give a causal local-dimension statement for the observed-law fiber.
body.consumer: Designers can rank candidate data additions by the number of target-relevant ambiguity directions they remove.
